prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with peak performance during a 20-mile long run scheduled for 10 AM
prompt_inputs.restrictions: No dairy, prefers plant-based protein sources

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three nutrition phases: pre-workout (2-3 hours before 10 AM run), intra-workout (fueling strategy during the run), and post-workout recovery
Macronutrient ratios appropriate for endurance athlete (carbohydrate-focused with adequate protein and minimal fat during training window)
All meals and snacks accommodate dairy-free, plant-based protein restrictions
Plan is concise and fits within a single day format with specific timing
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-intensity sport athlete (e.g., marathon runner) who requires specific macronutrient ratios and timing around training sessions, including pre-workout, intra-workout, and recovery nutrition

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain performance while cutting to 66 kg for competition in 10 days without losing strength

solution_criteria: Meal plan stays within 2,200-2,400 calories per day while meeting protein requirements (≥1.6g per kg body weight)
All meals align with stated dietary restrictions (vegetarian, dairy-free)
Includes nutrient-dense foods that support athletic performance and recovery
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with an athlete in a sport requiring weight management (e.g., boxer or gymnast) with caloric constraints, focusing on nutrient density and how to maintain performance while staying within strict calorie limits
